methods.name: aggregate dual-graph residual baseline family
methods.research_question: Can aggregate link, state and operational prediction pass the pre-GPU non-locked gates?
methods.why_tried: It provided the smallest executable bridge from the verified dual-graph tensor and deterministic rules to learned multi-step prediction.
methods.outcome: Some three-seed gates and communication diagnostics passed, but node-position rollout remained weaker than persistence and the method did not consume per-RB targets.
methods.why_not_current: It is an aggregate baseline rather than the current entity-aligned stochastic world model and cannot establish the intended entity-wise P4 method.
methods.summary_zh: 这是旧的聚合基线，只能提供诊断证据；它不是当前实体级随机世界模型，也不能证明目标 P4 方法。
reusable_lessons: do not confuse aggregate evidence with per-RB or entity-wise evidence
methods.claim_boundary: Historical non-locked aggregate baseline evidence only.

methods.name: physical-edge feedback routed into edge GRU
methods.research_question: Would routing rule feedback into the physical-edge GRU remove the failing-seed link-activity regression?
methods.why_tried: Static inspection showed the previous edge recurrent update did not directly consume the corrected physical-edge feedback.
methods.outcome: The frozen GPU sentinel completed and other numeric guards passed, but validation link-F1 delta was -0.2177333, below the -0.05 floor.
methods.why_not_current: The single-variable intervention did not repair the registered link gate, so follow-up seeds were stopped.
methods.summary_zh: 物理边反馈进入 GRU 后仍未修复验证集链路门，因此按冻结规则停止后续 seed。
reusable_lessons: a plausible routing mismatch is not a sufficient performance explanation
methods.claim_boundary: One frozen non-locked GPU sentinel; it diagnoses a rejected intervention, not the final method.

methods.name: link persistence-residual candidate
methods.research_question: Can predicting a residual around the previous link-activity state stabilize sparse link events?
methods.why_tried: Persistence was a strong link baseline, so predicting only changes was a simpler candidate than replacing the whole dynamics model.
methods.outcome: The sentinel preserved some state and operational gates but did not close the full P4 link and long-horizon requirements.
methods.why_not_current: A link-head repair alone could not provide entity-wise stochastic state evolution or close the complete P4 method boundary.
methods.summary_zh: 单独修链路头不能提供实体级随机状态演化，也不能闭合完整 P4 方法边界。
methods.superseded_by: entity_aligned_dual_graph_rssm_v1 retains a persistence-residual link head inside a broader entity-wise model
reusable_lessons: retain persistence as an explicit link baseline
separate link-head behavior from full world-model acceptance
methods.claim_boundary: Historical single-seed sentinel and diagnosis; not a standalone accepted method.

methods.name: global aggregate complete RSSM adapter
methods.research_question: Would a complete prior/posterior RSSM added to the formal dual-graph base pass the P4 sentinel?
methods.why_tried: It closed prior, posterior, KL, teacher reconstruction and prior-only rollout semantics missing from earlier RSSM-like interfaces.
methods.outcome: The valid v3 sentinel passed link non-inferiority and operational guards but failed node-x ratio at 1.2877405 > 1.25; first-principles audit also showed a shared global correction could not change within-step edge ranking.
methods.why_not_current: Its stochastic state was pooled globally and broadcast back to entities, which conflicts with entity-wise link ranking and motion differences required by the project definition.
methods.summary_zh: 随机状态先全局池化再广播，不能表达实体之间的链路排序和运动差异，因此被实体对齐 RSSM 替代。
reusable_lessons: reuse complete prior/posterior and prior-only semantics
keep stochastic state aligned to entities
checkpoint selection must follow the formal gates
methods.claim_boundary: Historical complete-RSSM sentinel and read-only diagnosis; it is not the current entity-aligned method.

methods.name: node-x residual non-degradation loss candidate
methods.research_question: Would penalizing harmful RSSM node-x corrections prevent the global complete RSSM position regression?
methods.why_tried: A checkpoint decomposition showed the RSSM correction pushed an otherwise passing deterministic base over the node-x gate.
methods.outcome: The loss reduced correction magnitude, but the shared base training trajectory worsened; final node-x ratio was 1.520584 and the sentinel remained No-Go.
methods.why_not_current: It treated one observed symptom while leaving the pooled latent, motion-input and shared-optimization causes unresolved.
methods.summary_zh: 该 loss 只处理一次位置退化现象，没有解决全局 latent、运动输入和共享优化轨迹等根因。
methods.superseded_by: entity_aligned_dual_graph_rssm_v1 with causal motion input and staged frozen-base training
reusable_lessons: a loss term can alter the whole shared optimization path
do not patch one metric before checking representation and training-stage causes
methods.claim_boundary: Historical single-variable sentinel failure; the loss is not part of the current method.

methods.name: v11 selector, ranking and allocation experiment family
methods.research_question: Can learned candidate generation, ranking or value reconstruction improve resource-allocation choices?
methods.why_tried: The family explored decision-interface identifiability, candidate support and ranking behavior before the current world-model state rollout was accepted.
methods.outcome: Many diagnostic runs and variants exist, but they do not establish a current world-model candidate-rollout planner or the present P4 state-prediction method.
methods.why_not_current: The current roadmap requires P4 world-model acceptance before P6 planning, and a direct candidate scorer is not equivalent to rolling every candidate through the world model.
methods.summary_zh: 当前路线要求先完成 P4；直接候选打分不等于让每个候选经过世界模型推演，因此不能作为正式规划器。
methods.superseded_by: no accepted planner yet; formal candidate-rollout planner remains a P6 prototype
reusable_lessons: do not promote a direct scorer to a world-model rollout planner
methods.claim_boundary: Historical decision diagnostics only; P6 is not open and no accepted planner exists.
